heading_path: Film and Creative Media Major Credit Requirement

entries.text: Complete 69 semester hours in the major.

college: College of Arts, Media and Design
overview_text: This program is designed to provide in-depth instruction in the highly influential and continually evolving arts of moving-image media. Film, television, art, audio, and streaming/social media have become increasingly intertwined. In this major, students study the formal, critical, analytical, logistical, performative, and technological skills to navigate interrelated media-making fields and practices.
